key_impacts: People were swept away and killed in Kedarnath, including a 16-year-old student working as a stable hand
People went missing after the floods and landslide in Kedarnath
Loss of life and property and disruption of basic services reported across Uttarakhand; children and adolescents hit hardest
State Primary School at Farkia was destroyed; the building became a pile of rubble
Schooling was disrupted; classes operated from two makeshift locations for two weeks
From 13 August the school was shifted to the Panchayat premises, where poor conditions hindered teaching and learning
missing_information: Exact geocoordinates of the school not provided
